closure_explanation: Targets: Theorems 4.1, 4.3, 4.8 (all requested). Theorem 4.1 is proved in Appendix B.1 from Assumptions 3.1, 3.3, Algorithm 1 and Lemma A.3; Theorem 4.3 in Appendix B.2 from Assumptions 3.2, 3.3, Algorithm 1 and Lemma A.3; Theorem 4.8 in Appendix B.3 from Assumption 4.7 and Algorithm 2 (Taylor expansion). Lemma A.3 is proved from Assumption 3.3 and Algorithm 1. Definitions used by the statements: notation/problem (PROB, incl. f^* > -infinity), Definition 3.5 (D35). Derived supporting nodes cover inline proof steps: DMAT (matrix facts incl. the nuclear/Frobenius relation of line 184), DDESC, DSTOCH, DEXEC1, DEXEC2, DMAIN, DGUAR41, DGUAR43, DTHIRD. Excluded: Definition 3.4 and Proposition 3.6 (Frobenius stationarity and its relation; not used by the statements or proofs, the relation ||A||_F <= ||A||_* <= sqrt(r)||A||_F is used inline and covered by DMAT), Corollaries 4.2/4.4 (deterministic corollaries, not requested, not used), Assumption 4.5, Lemma 4.6 and Lemmas A.1/A.2 (Lambda-norm smoothness, used only for Lemma 4.6), the star-convex Section 4.2 and Appendix C, the Newton-Schulz appendix (Algorithm 3), experiments, and the J <= 0 discussion inside the proof of Theorem 4.8. Convergence results in the closure: T41, T43, T48.
